scene_riley_00_intro.text: Riley finishes a sharp, fluid gymnastic pivot and laughs breathlessly. "Didn’t see you there. Enjoying the show?"

riley_A.text: You praise her skill, leaning in. Riley grins wickedly. "Careful. Compliments make me competitive."

riley_B.text: You mirror her energy with a playful challenge. "Oh?" Her eyes spark. "Game on."

riley_C.text: You talk about her training. She softens. "Most people only care about the medals."

riley_fail.text: Riley shrugs playfully. "Maybe another night." She bounces away, already distracted.

riley_success_1.text: "Come on," she whispers. "Let’s find somewhere we can actually breathe."

riley_success_2.text: She steps close, energy electric. "This intensity? I like it."

riley_success_tame.text: She smiles warmly. "Walk with me? I want to cool down somewhere quiet."
